description: Indexed content and file search with Microsoft tgrep, index status and rebuild timestamps.
view.name: Search and index
config.executable: Path to Microsoft tgrep 1.0.5. Supports ~/; searches PATH and ~/.local/bin.
config.pythonExecutable: Python 3 for POSIX flock and child process management (macOS/Linux).
config.maxResults: Maximum number of matching lines or file names.
config.maxOutputMB: Maximum search output size before stopping the process.
config.externalLockPath: Shared flock file used by an external updater. Default: <index-name>-update.lock next to the index folder.
config.language: Language for the search panel and extension messages. Applies immediately. Command titles follow the VS Code display language.
config.language.auto: Use the VS Code display language (English fallback).
